claims.says: Cascade Pass, elev 5392, distMi 3.6, note: 'Maintained trail tops out here; leave it for the climbers' path toward Johannesburg.'
East/Northeast from Cascade Pass trailhead; descend and cross Cascade River, then approach the northeast face via C-J couloir
